breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to remove the physically incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt: 'Treat the pure-bending normal stress as uniform over the section depth, so the stress at the neutral axis has the same sign as at the extreme fibers.' The ground truth correctly omits this instruction because it contradicts the linear stress distribution defined by the flexure formula. The generated specification retained this erroneous sentence, thus failing to resolve the inconsistency.
